title: Writing the marked set
statement: For any finite set $F$ of integers and integer $p$, start with the partial Boolean marking that assigns true at $0$, false on $F$, and is undefined elsewhere. If its value at $p$ is true, leave it unchanged; otherwise write false at $p$. The resulting marking is the one that assigns true at $0$, false on $F\cup\{p\}$, and is undefined elsewhere.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a finite set of integers
